== Overview ==

All HPP servers use a customized RMC response structure. The structure is nearly identical, the only difference being that the response omits the protocol ID field. The request format is identical to standard [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/RMC|RMC]] requests.


== Response Format ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Description
|-
| UInt32 || Size, excluding this field
|-
| Bool || Success flag
|}

'''On success:'''

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Description
|-
| UInt32 || Call ID of the request
|-
| UInt32 || Method ID, ORed with <code>0x8000</code>
|-
| || Response data
|}

'''On error:'''

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Description
|-
| UInt32 || Error code. See [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Result_Codes|Result Codes]]
|-
| UInt32 || Call ID of the request
|}
